summary.text: Chuck Kopp has served in the Alaska House of Representatives for District 10, in 2017 to 2020 and again since 2025, and is listed as Majority Leader.

paragraphs.text: According to his legislative biography, he holds a B.A. in justice from the University of Alaska Anchorage and worked in public safety for more than 20 years, including seven years as Chief of Police of Kenai.
The biography says he has also been chief of staff to two state senators and was a governor's appointee to the Alaska Judicial Council and the Alaska Police Standards Council.
